about: Fixed phrases and answers for a like-for-like comparison (docs/features/skill-discoverability/1-requirements.md § 8, step 2). Answers are committed before any run. `accept` lists every skill that counts as right, so an alias and its parent count alike; a `none` phrase has no right skill. Nothing runs these automatically.
